notes: PLEA v4 on Sepolia. Deploy these four contracts in order in one transaction: PLEA's transient deployment flag permits PleaLaunch to register itself once. PleaLaunch derives its owner from PLEA and commits to PleaHook's initcode hash. External protocol addresses are fixed in the accepted source. PleaHook is deployed separately through PleaLaunch.deployHook using the committed initcode and a salt mined with script/MineSalt.s.sol; this initializes PLEA and mints 90% to the hook and 10% to PleaDistributor. PleaLaunch.seed is callable once by the owner at any time after hook deployment, or by anyone from START 1791775740, and begins the 90-minute launch window. The owner may set the distributor's Merkle root once and add PLEA allowlist entries. These later actions are not manifest deployment calls.
